role: Implementation-level clarification of the already-preregistered A-E fit solvers; it changes no hypothesis, row, split, candidate family, selection rule, final gate, or tolerance after observing outcomes.

capture.adjoint_clip: Freeze the compiler_fit 99th percentile of row-token ||g||_2 separately per site; scale vectors above it radially to the threshold.
capture.gradient_boundary: The teacher coefficient tensor is a detached leaf. The deployed mo and every upstream state are detached at the target site, so backward traverses only the frozen suffix.
capture.forbidden: No compiler_final tensor is loaded before the complete validation/program/strata receipt is written. No validation gradient, label, target coefficient, or logit enters a fit loss.

affine.A_and_B_euclidean: Use the registered analytic ridge frontier and balanced rank truncation from the v1 pure contract, with A targeting c and B targeting p.

C_causal.normalization: Fit-only per-coordinate z mean and RMS scale, floor 1e-6.
C_causal.initialization: Initialize each lambda from its B full-rank Euclidean ridge map, then take the registered balanced rank truncation.
C_causal.optimizer: Deterministic AdamW on the two low-rank factors and intercept under the exact registered empirical-Fisher-plus-floor loss.

native.features: Compute phi_i=(L_i z)(R_i z) once from fit z; temporary feature/cache tensors are fit-only and forbidden from the serialized program.
native.intercept: D uses the Euclidean-optimal fit constant mean(p). E uses the exact fit empirical-Fisher-plus-floor optimal constant from a 64x64 linear solve.
native.quadratic: Form the exact fit-only Hessian and linear term for scalar gates, including the output-direction Gram Q Q^T. E adds the directional design phi_i*(Q_i dot g_t) plus isotropic floor 0.05.
native.lambda_max: max absolute smooth gradient at the zero gate vector
native.solver: Warm-start deterministic FISTA, 500 iterations/path point; Lipschitz constant from 64 seeded power iterations.
native.support: For each K in the registered grid, take top-|gate| support at every path point, refit amplitudes by the fixed-support quadratic solve with numerical ridge 1e-8 times max(1,max diagonal), and retain the fit-only support with lowest unpenalized smooth objective.
native.serialization: Serialize independent canonical L_i,R_i and amplitude-scaled Q_i plus the fitted 64-vector intercept; never serialize a checkpoint pointer, token, row index, label, activation, or fit feature.

selection_boundary: All families/ranks/supports are fit before direct validation suffix scoring. Validation may choose candidates but may not refit, alter support, or alter amplitudes. The 64-direction validation audit is diagnostic and cannot feed C/E.
retry_rule: Any solver/source failure is preserved. Retry uses a versioned namespace and a new committed source closure before another capture.
